'''2012 SoCal Grand Prix Anthony Howard LS Infiltration''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Anthony Howard]] at [[2012 SoCal Grand Prix]] (Grand Prix).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Infiltration / Unlikely Allies]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Grand Prix
